title: 生物安全柜安全操作基础：清理柜内溢洒

shots.scene: 欣欣站在生物安全柜旁，手里拿着一卷纸巾和一个喷壶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biological safety cabinet holding a roll of paper towels and a disinfectant squeeze bottle.
shots.narration: 这一课讲安全柜里洒了东西怎么办。
overlay: 生物安全柜内溢洒的清理

shots.scene: 四个图标排成一行：纸巾、喷壶、沙漏、废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: paper towels, a squeeze bottle, an hourglass and a biohazard waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 盖住、消毒、等待、处置。

shots.scene: 阿杰在柜内操作，一管样品翻倒，液体洒在台面上
shots.prompt_en: Inside a biological safety cabinet, a tube tips over in the young male student's gloved hand and pink liquid spills onto the work surface.
shots.narration: 阿杰手一滑，样品洒在了柜子里。

shots.scene: 阿杰慌张地抽出双手，四处张望
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls his hands out quickly and looks around in a panic.
shots.narration: 他慌了，不知道先做什么。

shots.scene: 小研拍拍他的肩，指向规程
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pats his shoulder and points to a blank procedure binder on the shelf.
shots.narration: 小研说：别慌，按溢洒规程来。

shots.scene: 台面上一滩粉红色的溢洒液
shots.prompt_en: A small pink liquid spill on the stainless steel work surface inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内溢洒，要马上清理和去污。

shots.scene: 放着不管的溢洒旁边，时钟在走，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a spill left alone with a ticking clock beside it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能放着等以后再说。

shots.scene: 小研戴好护目镜、手套，扣好实验服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks her safety goggles, gloves and buttoned lab coat before cleaning.
shots.narration: 动手前，先检查防护穿戴。

shots.scene: 实验服、护目镜、手套三个图标，各打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab coat, goggles and gloves, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 合适的防护，是清理的前提。

shots.scene: 书架上空白的溢洒处置规程和应急预案文件夹
shots.prompt_en: A shelf with blank spill response procedure binders and a blank emergency plan binder. No people.
shots.narration: 溢洒怎么处理，要事先写进规程。

shots.scene: 老周在组会上用空白挂图讲溢洒流程
shots.prompt_en: The older man explains a blank spill response flowchart to group members at a lab meeting.
shots.narration: 人人都要提前学会。

shots.scene: 柜旁放着溢洒处置包：纸巾、消毒剂、废物袋
shots.prompt_en: A spill kit box beside the cabinet with paper towels, a disinfectant bottle and a waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 处置用品就近备好。

shots.section_title: 大量或难处理的溢洒，请求协助
shots.scene: 大量液体流过前格栅，渗进下方
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a large spill flowing over the front grille and down into the drain trough below the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 洒得多，或流进格栅下面的集液槽，
overlay: 大量或难处理的溢洒，请求协助

shots.section_title: 大量或难处理的溢洒，请求协助
shots.scene: 小研打电话，王老师和老李赶来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call; the safety administrator and the facility engineer arrive.
shots.narration: 自己处理不了，就请安全部门协助。

shots.section_title: 台面小量溢洒的一般程序
shots.scene: 欣欣指着台面上的一小片溢洒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a small spill on the cabinet work surface.
shots.narration: 下面讲台面小量溢洒的一般做法。
overlay: 台面小量溢洒的一般程序

shots.section_title: 台面小量溢洒的一般程序
shots.scene: 空白规程文件夹上一个调节旋钮图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure binder with an adjustment knob icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 具体步骤，按工作内容和本室规程调整。

shots.scene: 小研用纸巾轻轻盖住溢洒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lays paper towels over the spill.
shots.narration: 第一步，用纸巾等吸水材料盖住。

shots.scene: 纸巾吸进粉红色液体
shots.prompt_en: Paper towels absorb the pink liquid and slowly change color. No people.
shots.narration: 先把液体吸住，别让它流开。

shots.scene: 小研拿起写着空白标签的消毒剂洗瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student picks up a squeeze bottle of the designated disinfectant with a blank label.
shots.narration: 用规程指定的液体消毒剂。

shots.scene: 洗瓶从纸巾外缘开始画圈，向中心挤消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: A squeeze bottle applies disinfectant onto the towels in circles, starting at the outer edge and moving toward the center. No people.
shots.narration: 从外缘开始，画着圈往中间浇。

shots.scene: 由外向内的螺旋箭头打勾；由内向外的箭头打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two diagrams: an inward spiral arrow with a green check, and an outward spreading arrow crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 由外向内，污染才不会扩大。

shots.scene: 小研收拢纸巾，尽量擦掉溢洒物
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gathers the wet towels and wipes up as much of the spill as possible.
shots.narration: 尽量把溢洒物擦干净。

shots.scene: 纸巾丢进柜内的生物危害废物袋
shots.prompt_en: The used towels drop into the biohazard waste bag inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 纸巾丢进柜内的生物危害废物袋。

shots.scene: 小研铺上新纸巾，再浇消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lays fresh paper towels on the area and wets them with disinfectant again.
shots.narration: 换新纸巾，再浇一遍消毒剂。

shots.scene: 湿纸巾留在台面，旁边一个沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Wet towels rest on the contaminated area with an hourglass icon beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 这次让湿纸巾留在原处，等足时间。

shots.scene: 沙漏旁边四个小图标
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass surrounded by four small icons: an organic smear, a microbe, a disinfectant bottle, and a concentration bar. No people.
shots.narration: 要等多久，取决于好几样因素。

shots.scene: 王老师指着空白规程中的时间栏
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points to a blank time column in a procedure binder.
shots.narration: 因素不同，所需时间也不同。

shots.scene: 沙漏流完，小研收起纸巾丢进废物袋
shots.prompt_en: The hourglass runs out; the female graduate student lifts the towels and drops them into the biohazard waste bag.
shots.narration: 时间到了，纸巾再丢进废物袋。

shots.scene: 不锈钢台面上出现小锈点的示意
shots.prompt_en: A close-up diagram of a stainless steel surface with small pitting spots next to a bleach bottle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 漂白剂会让不锈钢台面出现点蚀。

shots.scene: 小研用乙醇或清水润湿的纸巾再擦一遍
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the surface again with a towel wetted with ethanol or water.
shots.narration: 用了漂白剂，再用乙醇或水擦一遍。

shots.scene: 涡旋混合器外壳上溅了几个粉红点
shots.prompt_en: A small vortex mixer inside the cabinet with a few pink splash dots on its housing. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里被溅到的物品，也要去污。

shots.scene: 小研用消毒剂纸巾擦拭混合器外壳
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes the housing of the vortex mixer with a disinfectant-soaked towel.
shots.narration: 用消毒剂纸巾擦外表面。

shots.scene: 擦过的混合器表面湿润，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: The wiped mixer stays wet with an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 保持湿润，等足时间，

shots.scene: 小研重新坐下开始操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits back down and resumes work in the clean cabinet.
shots.narration: 再继续你的实验。

shots.section_title: 本课不替代本实验室规程
shots.scene: 欣欣举着空白的溢洒处置规程
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank spill response procedure binder.
shots.narration: 这一课是基础，具体以本实验室规程为准。
overlay: 本课不替代本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在干净的安全柜旁，身边浮现五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a clean biological safety cabinet with five icons floating beside it.
shots.narration: 记住处理溢洒的要点：

shots.scene: 阿杰按步骤清理完，小研在旁点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finishes cleaning step by step while the female graduate student nods.
shots.narration: 阿杰按步骤处理好，没有慌乱。

shots.scene: 干净的台面和擦过的混合器，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A clean cabinet work surface and a wiped vortex mixer with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 台面和物品都去污，再继续工作。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 冷静、规范，溢洒也不可怕。
